title: Shapeshifter: Copy many things, paste any
shortDescription: Copy many things, paste any of them. Hold Ctrl+V and your clipboard history appears: pick an item, release, and it's pasted. Text, images and files are kept exactly as copied, and nothing you copy leaves your computer.
description:
Copy many things. Paste any of them.

Tap Ctrl+V and it pastes as always. Keep holding Ctrl and your clipboard history appears. Press V to move down the list, release to paste. Shapeshifter stays out of the way until you need it.

More than plain text
Rich text, HTML, images, files and app-specific formats are kept and pasted back exactly as you copied them. Press the right arrow key to choose what to do with an item:
• Paste as plain text, without the formatting
• Paste an image or text as a file, or several files as one compressed file
• Open a copied link, or copy the image behind it
• Pin an item so it stays at the top, even after a restart

Find what you copied a while ago
Press S while the history is open and type a few words. Enter pastes what you found. 1–9 jump straight to an item, Delete removes one, Esc cancels. Press Space to keep the history open and look around at your own pace.

Private by design
Nothing you copy leaves your computer. Content that password managers mark as sensitive is never recorded. Only if you choose "Upload and paste link" for an image is that one image uploaded, so a link to it can be pasted.

Made to fit in
Shapeshifter follows your accent colour and light or dark mode, and speaks 22 languages. Prefer another shortcut? Use Win+V instead, in place of the Windows clipboard history.

Shapeshifter is open source (github.com/ffMathy/Shapeshifter). Buying it here supports its development.
